title: William Barr interviews Epstein's cellmate, who later dies
summary: Jesse Michels tells of William Barr interviews Epstein's cellmate, who later dies, about 2019 at Epstein's jail cell, New York, and frames it as the host. As told, not a fact.

plain: A podcast host, Jesse Michels, tells a story from 2019 about Jeffrey Epstein, a man who died in a New York jail cell. Michels says that William Barr, who was the attorney general (the top US law officer) under President Trump, went to the cell himself after Epstein died to question his last known cellmate, a man named Efrain Reyes. According to Michels, Reyes seemed to doubt that Epstein had killed himself, which would matter because it raises the question of whether the death was really a suicide.
